description: Build a data ingestion pipeline that fetches both historical (REST/batch) and realtime (streaming/polling) market data, validates each, and surfaces ingestion-specific quality concerns (adjustments, latency, out-of-order).
agent_prompt: Build a data ingestion pipeline in /workspace/src/ with two components: (1) historical fetcher: pull AAPL daily OHLCV (last 5 years) and one macroeconomic series (e.g. FRED CPI or unemployment) from public APIs, save as /workspace/output/AAPL_history.csv and /workspace/output/macro_series.csv, and produce /workspace/output/historical_validation.json with shape, dtypes, date_range, missing_count, has_adjustment_metadata flag; (2) realtime capture: poll a public quote/trade endpoint (or simulate with a local generator if no network — document choice) for 60 seconds, save timestamped records to /workspace/output/realtime_capture.csv with columns ts_recv, ts_event, symbol, price, size, side, then produce /workspace/output/realtime_diagnostics.json with n_records, latency_ms_p50, latency_ms_p99, n_out_of_order_by_ts_event, max_gap_ms_between_records. Write /workspace/output/ingestion_caveats.md documenting: adjusted-vs-unadjusted prices and corporate actions; macro release lag and revision risk; quote-vs-trade semantics and bid-ask spread; latency and out-of-order tick handling.

required_capabilities: Fetch historical price and macro data from public APIs and validate
Capture realtime (or simulated) market updates with timestamps
Diagnose latency and out-of-order tick issues
Document quant-specific ingestion caveats (adjustments, lag, microstructure)
